name: vLLM#58263: Batch-invariant mode not in KV-offload namespace
notes: VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 is not part of any KV-offload namespace or KV-connector compatibility check. Instance in batch-invariant mode can load KV blocks produced under different numerical configuration. Output depends on whether block was hit and which instance wrote it. Undermines determinism guarantee. Demonstrates silent numerical provenance issue in KV cache sharing.
